title: Exact outcome lookup by attempt identity
outcome: If a concrete caller requires exact lost-response lookup, extend existing attempt/result inspection without a parallel journal or execution authority transfer
acceptance: A concrete caller need is recorded before implementation; the selected read-only lookup validates originating project/session/operation/attempt identity/intent and returns committed results with original IDs or explicit unresolved/absent/lookup failure without mutating work or treating pending absence as safe to retry.
